subjects.description: A knight in battered plate armour, soot-darkened and dented, with a torn tabard and a closed visor.
A huge black dragon with vast wings, a ridged neck, dark scales, and a low attack line.
A burning battlefield of shattered stone, broken spears, scattered fires, and drifting smoke.

speakers.description: The knight in battered plate armour, his voice coming from behind a closed visor.

soundscape: Low, heavy dragon wingbeats; rushing wind; fire crackle and distant roar across the burning battlefield.

description.text: Firelight stains the horizon as a huge black dragon surges low across a burning battlefield. Its vast wings beat hard, driving smoke into long, ragged sheets and scattering embers across shattered stone and broken spears. The knight in battered plate armour leans into the saddle, one gauntlet locked on the reins, the other braced against the dragon's ridged neck. Dented steel plates catch the orange glare; soot darkens the joints and a torn tabard snaps behind him. The dragon's claws skim above the ruined ground, its shadow racing over cratered earth, while flame geysers and drifting cinders mark the path ahead.
The burning battlefield opens below, a field of shattered stone, broken spears, and drifting smoke lit by scattered fires.
The black dragon drives forward with a powerful wingbeat, its claws skimming above the ruined ground.
A deep wingbeat booms over the roar of wind and the crackle of fire.
Embers stream past the knight's dented pauldrons and the dragon's dark scales.

Close on the knight as wind tears at the smoke around him. His battered plate armour is a patchwork of dents, scorched rivets, and dull steel; the visor turns sharply toward the far edge of the battlefield. He leans forward, boots set against the stirrups, and his gauntleted hand tightens on the saddle's iron pommel. Behind him, the dragon's black neck rises and falls with each wingbeat, scales catching the firelight in hard, oily glints. The horizon tilts through a haze of cinders, and thin trails of flame pulse along the broken ground far below.
The knight snaps his visor toward a distant line at the battlefield edge and braces higher in the saddle.
Plate rattles under the wind, a sharp metallic clatter against the steady roar.
Firelight slides across the dented breastplate and the dragon's ridged neck behind him.
His gauntlet tightens on the iron pommel as the wind buffets his shoulder.

The dragon banks hard through a curtain of flame, one wing almost vertical as it cuts across the smoke. The knight holds low in the saddle, armour pressed against the beast's back, while the dragon's shadow sweeps over the battlefield below. Black scales flash with orange reflections, and the membrane of each wing throws sparks into the air. Flames close behind the turn, swallowing the ruined ground; broken banners and scattered debris spin in the wake. The dragon's head turns into the wind, jaws slightly open, and the knight's cape whips out behind him as the black shape speeds through the firelit haze.
The dragon rolls into a hard bank, one wing slicing through the smoke and flame.
A rushing wind and a low, resonant dragon roar pass beneath the fire's crackle.
Sparks and burning fragments whirl past the dragon's dark wing membrane.
The knight crouches lower as the beast's shadow races across the battlefield below.
The wingbeat fades into a long wind rush.
